//: Northwind platform MCP server — drop-in config for any MCP client.
The identity you connect as decides which tools you receive. Try each of
the four and watch tools/list change:
platform-agent   12 of 14 tools — can propose, cannot approve
drift-agent       5 of 14 tools — read-mostly, no cluster mutation at all
release-manager  14 of 14 tools — a human in the owning group
Same server, same code path, different world. The filter runs before the
model sees the list, so an agent cannot be talked into a tool it does not
have; the capability is absent, not forbidden.
claude mcp add northwind -- python3 src/platform_mcp.py
claude mcp add --transport http northwind http://127.0.0.1:8099/mcp
